_about: Round 4 'this or that' pairs. Each pair is one axis that splits subjects in the data (see onet_profiles.py and the HESA analysis). Tap one side; 'skip' scores nothing. Image prompts are scene descriptions to combine with the house style block; no text, no faces.
_scoring: Picking a side adds +1 to its measure and -0.5 to the opposite measure (for opposed measures). Subjects are then matched on z-scores of subject_profiles; 'path' uses HESA top-job share.
